promptZh: 阅读短文，在空白处填入 1 个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文赞美英语高老师十五年如一日用新点子教英语，帮助学生不怕犯错、爱上英语。
explanation.ruleZh: for/since 时间状语配完成时，although 引导让步从句，more carefully 为副词比较级，which 引导非限制性定语从句。

evidence.quote: my spoken English ____ (improve) a lot since last September
Although she checks our homework ____ (careful) than any other teacher, she never blames us

segments.text: (teach) English at our school for fifteen years, but she still prepares every class with fresh ideas and often stays late marking papers.
she has taught some lessons many times, her classes are never boring;
, she always finds new ways to make us think. Last term, she started an English corner after class, where students practice
(speak) by describing pictures, telling stories and acting out short dialogues in English. She often says that making mistakes is an important part of
(learn), so nobody should be afraid of them. Although she checks our homework
(careful) than any other teacher, she never blames us. When we make the same mistake again, she simply explains it one
(many) time with a smile. Thanks to her help, my spoken English
(improve) a lot since last September, and I am no longer afraid of opening my mouth. Under her influence, I have fallen in love with English,
I once hated most. I believe I

gaps.label: 第1空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: for fifteen years 与现在完成时连用，填 has taught 或 has been teaching。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.explanationZh: 引导让步状语从句表示“尽管”，填 Although/Even though/Though。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.explanationZh: 分号后表示“相反/然而”，填 instead 或 however。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: practice doing sth 表示“练习做某事”，填 speaking。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 介词 of 后接动名词，填 learning。

gaps.label: 第6空
gaps.clue: 用括号内副词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 由 than any other teacher 可知用副词比较级 more carefully。

gaps.label: 第7空
gaps.clue: 用括号内词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: one more time 表示“再一次”，填 more。

gaps.label: 第8空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: since last September 与现在完成时连用，填 has improved。

gaps.label: 第9空
gaps.explanationZh: 非限制性定语从句指代 English，从句中 hated 缺宾语，填 which。

gaps.label: 第10空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 表示将来的信念，用一般将来时 will remember。
